anti_trude_vector: Triple architectural chamber triptych (Living arcades, Stone-Slab Necropolis, Porous Sponge-Marble Unborn Domes) morphing causally into a claustrophobic Stadium-Funnel Amphitheater and an Unturned Finite-Grain Hourglass.

canonical_stones.label: Laudomia of the Living
canonical_stones.calvino_axiom: Crowded streets of the living who visit the other two cities bearing the same name to seek explanations of themselves, security, and freedom from chaos.

canonical_stones.label: Laudomia of the Dead (Stone-Slab Necropolis)
canonical_stones.calvino_axiom: Ever-broadening cemetery beyond the walls along hearse-narrow windowless lanes whose stone slabs preserve ancient surnames, guilds, ranks, and necessary order.
canonical_stones.causal_invariant: d(deadSlabsCount)/dt >= 0 && consultNecropolis(clanIdx) increases orderClarity and livingSecurity

canonical_stones.label: Laudomia of the Unborn (Porous Marble Niches)
canonical_stones.calvino_axiom: Fine hollow marble architecture of porous, sponge-like domes and empty niches without furnishings or carved names, holding only footstep-echoing silence, pure expectation, and uncountable potentiality.
canonical_stones.causal_invariant: unbornFurnishings === 0 && enterUnbornHollows(nicheIdx) triggers hollow echo and expectation

canonical_stones.label: First Anguish: Stadium-Funnel Suffocation
canonical_stones.calvino_axiom: Envisioning billions of the dead and the unborn swarming every pore of the spongy stone and packed into stadium-like amphitheater steps until Laudomia chokes on its own past and future.
canonical_stones.causal_invariant: anguishMode === 'funnel' && intensifyFunnel() drives funnelDensity -> 1.0 and isChoking === true

canonical_stones.label: Second Anguish: Unturned-Hourglass Extinction
canonical_stones.calvino_axiom: Envisioning Laudomia as finite grains of sand in an hourglass that no hand turns over again, where every birth and death drains a grain toward the last birth and silent disappearance.
canonical_stones.causal_invariant: canTurnHourglass === false && drainHourglass() drives grainsRemaining -> 0 and lastGrainFallen === true

keyboard.T: Attempt to Turn Hourglass (refused by fate)

royal_plates_policy.drawer_wiring: Wire and inside hidden-by-default with inline onerror revealing self-contained archival canvas/notice so page load has 0 console errors.
